metaDescription: Five copy paste Navratri AI photo editing prompts. Mandir, marigold, couple and Ashtami white red looks by Bipul Kumar.

faqItems.question: Can I use these Navratri prompts without a dandiya dress?
faqItems.answer: Yes. These five use home mandir, kurta and saree looks. No dandiya sticks are needed for any of them.

faqItems.question: How do I keep the festive look natural?
faqItems.answer: Upload a daylight photo and paste the prompt as is. The prompts use soft diya light so skin stays natural.

faqItems.question: Do couple photos need two uploads?
faqItems.answer: Yes. For the pastel balcony couple look, upload one photo per person so both faces stay locked.
